<section class="level2" id="la-sortie-complète-de-summary">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="la-sortie-complète-de-summary">La sortie complète de summary</h3>

<div class="sourceCode" id="cb1"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb1-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-1" tabindex="-1"></a>sal <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">read.csv</span>(<span class="st">"salaires.csv"</span>, <span class="at">stringsAsFactors =</span> <span class="cn">TRUE</span>)</span>
<span id="cb1-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-2" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">summary</span>(<span class="fu">lm</span>(salaire <span class="sc">~</span> anciennete <span class="sc">+</span> diplome, <span class="at">data =</span> sal))</span>
<span id="cb1-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-3" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co">#</span></span>
<span id="cb1-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-4" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># Call:</span></span>
<span id="cb1-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-5" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># lm(formula = salaire ~ anciennete + diplome, data = sal)</span></span>
<span id="cb1-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-6" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co">#</span></span>
<span id="cb1-7"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-7" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># Residuals:</span></span>
<span id="cb1-8"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-8" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co">#     Min      1Q  Median      3Q     Max</span></span>
<span id="cb1-9"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-9" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># -3541.7 -1056.2  -192.4  1048.0  6269.9</span></span>
<span id="cb1-10"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-10" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co">#</span></span>
<span id="cb1-11"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-11" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># Coefficients:</span></span>
<span id="cb1-12"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-12" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co">#              Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(&gt;|t|)</span></span>
<span id="cb1-13"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-13" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># (Intercept)   3320.42     158.85  20.902  &lt; 2e-16</span></span>
<span id="cb1-14"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-14" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># anciennete     270.27      11.72  23.059  &lt; 2e-16</span></span>
<span id="cb1-15"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-15" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># diplomeBac+2  1099.57     158.59   6.933 1.29e-11</span></span>
<span id="cb1-16"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-16" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># diplomeBac+5  3336.99     184.25  18.111  &lt; 2e-16</span></span>
<span id="cb1-17"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-17" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co">#</span></span>
<span id="cb1-18"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-18" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># Residual standard error: 1561 on 496 degrees of freedom</span></span>
<span id="cb1-19"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-19" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># Multiple R-squared:  0.6418, Adjusted R-squared:  0.6396</span></span>
<span id="cb1-20"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-20" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># F-statistic: 296.2 on 3 and 496 DF,  p-value: &lt; 2.2e-16</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="chaque-ligne-et-le-chapitre-qui-la-établie">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="chaque-ligne-et-le-chapitre-qui-la-établie">Chaque ligne, et le chapitre qui l’a établie</h3>
<details class="definitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">De haut en bas</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<table class="caption-top table">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 27%"/>
<col style="width: 27%"/>
<col style="width: 45%"/>
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th>Ligne de la sortie</th>
<th>Ce que c’est</th>
<th style="text-align: center;">Ch.</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td><code>Residuals</code></td>
<td>quartiles des <span class="math inline">e_i</span></td>
<td style="text-align: center;">2, 12</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td><code>Estimate</code></td>
<td>les <span class="math inline">\widehat{\beta}_j</span></td>
<td style="text-align: center;">3, 7</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td><code>Std. Error</code></td>
<td><span class="math inline">\widehat{\sigma}(\widehat{\beta}_j)</span>, sous H3 et H4</td>
<td style="text-align: center;">5, 11</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td><code>t value</code>, <code>Pr(&gt;|t|)</code></td>
<td>test de <span class="math inline">\beta_j = 0</span></td>
<td style="text-align: center;">5</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td><code>Residual standard error</code></td>
<td><span class="math inline">\widehat{\sigma}_\varepsilon</span></td>
<td style="text-align: center;">4</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td><code>R-squared</code></td>
<td><span class="math inline">R^2</span>, <span class="math inline">R^2</span> ajusté</td>
<td style="text-align: center;">4, 8</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td><code>F-statistic</code></td>
<td>test global</td>
<td style="text-align: center;">9</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
</details>
<p><strong>Ce que la sortie ne dit pas</strong> : ses écarts-types sont ordinaires, valides sous H3 et H4 seulement.</p>
</section>
</section>
<section class="level1" id="sur-r">
<h2 class="h1">Sur R</h2>
<section class="level2" id="estimer-et-encadrer">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="estimer-et-encadrer">Estimer et encadrer</h3>

<div class="sourceCode" id="cb2"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb2-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb2-1" tabindex="-1"></a>sal <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">read.csv</span>(<span class="st">"salaires.csv"</span>, <span class="at">stringsAsFactors =</span> <span class="cn">TRUE</span>)</span>
<span id="cb2-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb2-2" tabindex="-1"></a>sal<span class="sc">$</span>diplome <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">relevel</span>(sal<span class="sc">$</span>diplome, <span class="at">ref =</span> <span class="st">"Bac"</span>)  <span class="co"># la référence</span></span>
<span id="cb2-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb2-3" tabindex="-1"></a>m1 <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">lm</span>(salaire <span class="sc">~</span> anciennete, <span class="at">data =</span> sal)</span>
<span id="cb2-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb2-4" tabindex="-1"></a>m2 <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">update</span>(m1, . <span class="sc">~</span> . <span class="sc">+</span> diplome)</span>
<span id="cb2-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb2-5" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">round</span>(<span class="fu">confint</span>(m2), <span class="dv">2</span>)                <span class="co"># Student à 496 ddl</span></span>
<span id="cb2-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb2-6" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co">#                2.5 %  97.5 %</span></span>
<span id="cb2-7"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb2-7" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># (Intercept)  3008.31 3632.53</span></span>
<span id="cb2-8"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb2-8" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># anciennete    247.24  293.30</span></span>
<span id="cb2-9"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb2-9" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># diplomeBac+2  787.98 1411.16</span></span>
<span id="cb2-10"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb2-10" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># diplomeBac+5 2974.98 3699.00</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="diagnostiquer">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="diagnostiquer">Diagnostiquer</h3>

<div class="sourceCode" id="cb3"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb3-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">suppressPackageStartupMessages</span>({<span class="fu">library</span>(lmtest); <span class="fu">library</span>(car)})</span>
<span id="cb3-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-2" tabindex="-1"></a>sal <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">read.csv</span>(<span class="st">"salaires.csv"</span>, <span class="at">stringsAsFactors =</span> <span class="cn">TRUE</span>)</span>
<span id="cb3-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-3" tabindex="-1"></a>m2 <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">lm</span>(salaire <span class="sc">~</span> anciennete <span class="sc">+</span> diplome, <span class="at">data =</span> sal)</span>
<span id="cb3-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-4" tabindex="-1"></a>m4 <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">update</span>(m2, . <span class="sc">~</span> . <span class="sc">+</span> sexe <span class="sc">+</span> region)</span>
<span id="cb3-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-5" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">bptest</span>(m2)<span class="sc">$</span>statistic                 <span class="co"># Breusch-Pagan</span></span>
<span id="cb3-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-6" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co">#       BP</span></span>
<span id="cb3-7"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-7" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># 57.59655</span></span>
<span id="cb3-8"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-8" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">round</span>(<span class="fu">vif</span>(m4)[, <span class="dv">1</span>], <span class="dv">2</span>)               <span class="co"># VIF généralisés</span></span>
<span id="cb3-9"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-9" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># anciennete    diplome       sexe     region</span></span>
<span id="cb3-10"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-10" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co">#       1.01       1.01       1.01       1.02</span></span>
<span id="cb3-11"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-11" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">shapiro.test</span>(<span class="fu">residuals</span>(m2))<span class="sc">$</span>p.value  <span class="co"># normalité</span></span>
<span id="cb3-12"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-12" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># [1] 3.638585e-06</span></span>
<span id="cb3-13"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-13" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">sum</span>(<span class="fu">cooks.distance</span>(m2) <span class="sc">&gt;</span> <span class="dv">4</span> <span class="sc">/</span> <span class="fu">nrow</span>(sal))   <span class="co"># points à examiner</span></span>
<span id="cb3-14"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-14" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># [1] 33</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="des-vif-généralisés">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="des-vif-généralisés">Des VIF généralisés</h3>
<details class="ecobox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Un VIF par facteur</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p><code>car::vif</code> regroupe les indicatrices d’un même facteur : la région a un VIF généralisé de <span class="math inline">1{,}02</span>, alors que ses indicatrices ont, une à une, des VIF voisins de <span class="math inline">2</span> — la liaison entre elles est due à la construction, pas aux données.</p>
</div>
</details>
<details class="intuitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Shapiro plutôt que Jarque-Bera</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p>R propose d’emblée le test de Shapiro-Wilk, plus puissant que Jarque-Bera : <span class="math inline">p = 3{,}6 \times 10^{-6}</span>, même conclusion qu’au chapitre 17 — et la même absence de conséquence sur <span class="math inline">500</span> observations.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="la-commande-la-plus-rentable">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="la-commande-la-plus-rentable">La commande la plus rentable</h3>
<details class="definitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">plot(m2)</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p><code>par(mfrow = c(2, 2)) ; plot(m2)</code> produit les quatre graphiques du chapitre 12 en une instruction : résidus contre valeurs ajustées, quantile-quantile, échelle-position, résidus contre levier.</p>
</div>
</details>
<details class="ecobox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Quatre secondes, et l’essentiel du diagnostic est fait</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p>La figure du chapitre 12 a été produite exactement ainsi. Le premier panneau montre l’éventail de l’hétéroscédasticité, le deuxième le décrochage des hauts salaires : deux chapitres entiers, annoncés par une image.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="corriger">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="corriger">Corriger</h3>

<div class="sourceCode" id="cb4"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb4-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">suppressPackageStartupMessages</span>(<span class="fu">library</span>(lmtest))</span>
<span id="cb4-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-2" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">library</span>(sandwich)</span>
<span id="cb4-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-3" tabindex="-1"></a>sal <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">read.csv</span>(<span class="st">"salaires.csv"</span>, <span class="at">stringsAsFactors =</span> <span class="cn">TRUE</span>)</span>
<span id="cb4-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-4" tabindex="-1"></a>m2 <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">lm</span>(salaire <span class="sc">~</span> anciennete <span class="sc">+</span> diplome, <span class="at">data =</span> sal)</span>
<span id="cb4-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-5" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">coeftest</span>(m2, <span class="at">vcov =</span> <span class="fu">vcovHC</span>(m2, <span class="at">type =</span> <span class="st">"HC1"</span>))</span>
<span id="cb4-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-6" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co">#</span></span>
<span id="cb4-7"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-7" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># t test of coefficients:</span></span>
<span id="cb4-8"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-8" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co">#</span></span>
<span id="cb4-9"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-9" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co">#              Estimate Std. Error t value  Pr(&gt;|t|)</span></span>
<span id="cb4-10"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-10" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># (Intercept)  3320.421    144.365 23.0002 &lt; 2.2e-16</span></span>
<span id="cb4-11"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-11" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># anciennete    270.269     13.003 20.7844 &lt; 2.2e-16</span></span>
<span id="cb4-12"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-12" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># diplomeBac+2 1099.570    138.431  7.9431 1.332e-14</span></span>
<span id="cb4-13"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-13" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># diplomeBac+5 3336.992    226.280 14.7472 &lt; 2.2e-16</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="lenquête-de-ménages">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="lenquête-de-ménages">L’enquête de ménages</h3>

<div class="sourceCode" id="cb5"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb5-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">suppressPackageStartupMessages</span>({<span class="fu">library</span>(lmtest); <span class="fu">library</span>(car)})</span>
<span id="cb5-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-2" tabindex="-1"></a>men <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">read.csv</span>(<span class="st">"menages.csv"</span>, <span class="at">stringsAsFactors =</span> <span class="cn">TRUE</span>)</span>
<span id="cb5-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-3" tabindex="-1"></a>mk <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">lm</span>(consommation <span class="sc">~</span> revenu, <span class="at">data =</span> men)</span>
<span id="cb5-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-4" tabindex="-1"></a>mk2 <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">lm</span>(consommation <span class="sc">~</span> revenu <span class="sc">+</span> taille <span class="sc">+</span> milieu, <span class="at">data =</span> men)</span>
<span id="cb5-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-5" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">linearHypothesis</span>(mk, <span class="st">"revenu = 1"</span>)<span class="sc">$</span>F[<span class="dv">2</span>]       <span class="co"># Keynes : F = t^2</span></span>
<span id="cb5-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-6" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># [1] 426.9366</span></span>
<span id="cb5-7"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-7" tabindex="-1"></a>V <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> sandwich<span class="sc">::</span><span class="fu">vcovCL</span>(mk2, <span class="at">cluster =</span> <span class="sc">~</span> quartier)</span>
<span id="cb5-8"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-8" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">round</span>(<span class="fu">unclass</span>(<span class="fu">coeftest</span>(mk2, <span class="at">vcov =</span> V))[, <span class="dv">1</span><span class="sc">:</span><span class="dv">3</span>], <span class="dv">3</span>)</span>
<span id="cb5-9"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-9" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co">#              Estimate Std. Error t value</span></span>
<span id="cb5-10"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-10" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># (Intercept)   497.336     97.028   5.126</span></span>
<span id="cb5-11"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-11" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># revenu          0.705      0.023  30.349</span></span>
<span id="cb5-12"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-12" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># taille         70.669     12.291   5.750</span></span>
<span id="cb5-13"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-13" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># milieuUrbain  -99.440    101.917  -0.976</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="deux-lignes-concluent-deux-chapitres">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="deux-lignes-concluent-deux-chapitres">Deux lignes concluent deux chapitres</h3>
<details class="ecobox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">linearHypothesis et vcovCL</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p><code>linearHypothesis</code> teste n’importe quelle contrainte linéaire — ici la restriction que la théorie de Keynes impose : <span class="math inline">F = 426{,}9 = (-20{,}66)^2</span>. <strong>La démarche des quatre étapes s’achève sur une commande.</strong></p>
<p><code>vcovCL</code> corrige le regroupement : l’écart-type du milieu urbain passe de <span class="math inline">55{,}69</span> à <span class="math inline">101{,}92</span>, parce que cette variable est <strong>constante dans le quartier</strong>.</p>
</div>
</details>
<details class="intuitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Ce test-là utilise les écarts-types ordinaires</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p>Sans autre précision, <code>linearHypothesis</code> prend la variance des MCO. Pour un test robuste aux grappes, on lui passe <code>vcov. = vcovCL(...)</code> : le <span class="math inline">t</span> de Keynes tombe alors à <span class="math inline">-14{,}3</span>, comme au chapitre 20.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
</section>
<section class="level1" id="sur-python">
<h2 class="h1">Sur Python</h2>
<section class="level2" id="estimer">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="estimer">Estimer</h3>

<div class="sourceCode" id="cb6"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb6-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">import</span> pandas <span class="im">as</span> pd</span>
<span id="cb6-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-2" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">import</span> statsmodels.formula.api <span class="im">as</span> smf</span>
<span id="cb6-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-3" tabindex="-1"></a>sal <span class="op">=</span> pd.read_csv(<span class="st">"salaires.csv"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb6-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-4" tabindex="-1"></a>f <span class="op">=</span> <span class="st">"salaire ~ anciennete + C(diplome, Treatment('Bac'))"</span></span>
<span id="cb6-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-5" tabindex="-1"></a>m2 <span class="op">=</span> smf.ols(f, data<span class="op">=</span>sal).fit()</span>
<span id="cb6-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-6" tabindex="-1"></a>t <span class="op">=</span> pd.DataFrame({<span class="st">"coef"</span>: m2.params, <span class="st">"se"</span>: m2.bse,</span>
<span id="cb6-7"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-7" tabindex="-1"></a>                  <span class="st">"t"</span>: m2.tvalues})</span>
<span id="cb6-8"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-8" tabindex="-1"></a>t.index <span class="op">=</span> [<span class="st">"const"</span>, <span class="st">"Bac+2"</span>, <span class="st">"Bac+5"</span>, <span class="st">"anciennete"</span>]</span>
<span id="cb6-9"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-9" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">print</span>(t.<span class="bu">round</span>(<span class="dv">2</span>))</span>
<span id="cb6-10"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-10" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co">#                coef      se      t</span></span>
<span id="cb6-11"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-11" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># const       3320.42  158.85  20.90</span></span>
<span id="cb6-12"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-12" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># Bac+2       1099.57  158.59   6.93</span></span>
<span id="cb6-13"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-13" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># Bac+5       3336.99  184.25  18.11</span></span>
<span id="cb6-14"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-14" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># anciennete   270.27   11.72  23.06</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="tester-et-corriger">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="tester-et-corriger">Tester et corriger</h3>

<div class="sourceCode" id="cb7"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb7-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">import</span> pandas <span class="im">as</span> pd</span>
<span id="cb7-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-2" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">import</span> statsmodels.formula.api <span class="im">as</span> smf</span>
<span id="cb7-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-3" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">import</span> statsmodels.stats.api <span class="im">as</span> sms</span>
<span id="cb7-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-4" tabindex="-1"></a>sal <span class="op">=</span> pd.read_csv(<span class="st">"salaires.csv"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb7-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-5" tabindex="-1"></a>m1 <span class="op">=</span> smf.ols(<span class="st">"salaire ~ anciennete"</span>, data<span class="op">=</span>sal).fit()</span>
<span id="cb7-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-6" tabindex="-1"></a>m2 <span class="op">=</span> smf.ols(<span class="st">"salaire ~ anciennete + diplome"</span>, data<span class="op">=</span>sal).fit()</span>
<span id="cb7-7"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-7" tabindex="-1"></a>F, p, q <span class="op">=</span> m2.compare_f_test(m1)       <span class="co"># Fisher partiel</span></span>
<span id="cb7-8"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-8" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">print</span>(<span class="bu">round</span>(F, <span class="dv">2</span>), <span class="ss">f"</span><span class="sc">{</span>p<span class="sc">:.1e}</span><span class="ss">"</span>, q)</span>
<span id="cb7-9"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-9" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># 164.01 2.1e-55 2.0</span></span>
<span id="cb7-10"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-10" tabindex="-1"></a>bp <span class="op">=</span> sms.het_breuschpagan(m2.resid, m2.model.exog)</span>
<span id="cb7-11"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-11" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">print</span>(<span class="bu">round</span>(bp[<span class="dv">0</span>], <span class="dv">2</span>), <span class="ss">f"</span><span class="sc">{</span>bp[<span class="dv">1</span>]<span class="sc">:.1e}</span><span class="ss">"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb7-12"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-12" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># 57.6 1.9e-12</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="la-correspondance-des-commandes">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="la-correspondance-des-commandes">La correspondance des commandes</h3>
<details class="definitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">R et Python, ligne à ligne</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<table class="caption-top table">
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th>R</th>
<th>Python</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td><code>lm</code></td>
<td><code>smf.ols(...).fit()</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td><code>relevel</code></td>
<td><code>C(var, Treatment('ref'))</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td><code>anova(m1, m2)</code></td>
<td><code>m2.compare_f_test(m1)</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td><code>bptest</code></td>
<td><code>het_breuschpagan</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td><code>vcovHC(type = "HC1")</code></td>
<td><code>fit(cov_type="HC1")</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td><code>vcovCL</code></td>
<td><code>cov_type="cluster", cov_kwds={...}</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td><code>vif</code></td>
<td><code>variance_inflation_factor</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td><code>linearHypothesis</code></td>
<td><code>f_test</code>, <code>t_test</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td><code>cooks.distance</code></td>
<td><code>get_influence().cooks_distance</code></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="la-régression-finale-de-mincer">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="la-régression-finale-de-mincer">La régression finale de Mincer</h3>

<div class="sourceCode" id="cb8"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb8-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb8-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">import</span> numpy <span class="im">as</span> np, pandas <span class="im">as</span> pd</span>
<span id="cb8-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb8-2" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">import</span> statsmodels.formula.api <span class="im">as</span> smf</span>
<span id="cb8-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb8-3" tabindex="-1"></a>sal <span class="op">=</span> pd.read_csv(<span class="st">"salaires.csv"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb8-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb8-4" tabindex="-1"></a>sal[<span class="st">"lsal"</span>] <span class="op">=</span> np.log(sal.salaire)</span>
<span id="cb8-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb8-5" tabindex="-1"></a>f <span class="op">=</span> <span class="st">"lsal ~ anciennete + C(diplome, Treatment('Bac'))"</span> \</span>
<span id="cb8-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb8-6" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="st">" + C(region, Treatment('Autres'))"</span></span>
<span id="cb8-7"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb8-7" tabindex="-1"></a>mincer <span class="op">=</span> smf.ols(f, data<span class="op">=</span>sal).fit(cov_type<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"HC1"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb8-8"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb8-8" tabindex="-1"></a>b <span class="op">=</span> mincer.params</span>
<span id="cb8-9"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb8-9" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">print</span>(b[[<span class="st">"anciennete"</span>]].<span class="bu">round</span>(<span class="dv">4</span>).tolist(), <span class="bu">round</span>(b.iloc[<span class="dv">2</span>], <span class="dv">4</span>))</span>
<span id="cb8-10"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb8-10" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># [0.0345] 0.4353</span></span>
<span id="cb8-11"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb8-11" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">print</span>(<span class="bu">round</span>(mincer.rsquared, <span class="dv">3</span>))</span>
<span id="cb8-12"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb8-12" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># 0.654</span></span>
<span id="cb8-13"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb8-13" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">print</span>((<span class="dv">100</span> <span class="op">*</span> (np.exp(b) <span class="op">-</span> <span class="dv">1</span>)).<span class="bu">round</span>(<span class="dv">1</span>).tolist()[<span class="dv">1</span>:])   <span class="co"># exacts</span></span>
<span id="cb8-14"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb8-14" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># [19.6, 54.5, 18.0, 14.8, 6.1, 3.5]</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
</section>
</section>
<section class="level1" id="ce-que-le-logiciel-ne-fait-pas">
<h2 class="h1">Ce que le logiciel ne fait pas</h2>
<section class="level2" id="trois-choses-et-ce-sont-les-trois-qui-comptent">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="trois-choses-et-ce-sont-les-trois-qui-comptent">Trois choses, et ce sont les trois qui comptent</h3>
<details class="ecobox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Il ne choisit pas les variables</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p>La spécification vient de la théorie économique. Aucune procédure automatique ne remplace la question : <em>quelles variables devraient figurer dans ce modèle, et lesquelles manquent ?</em></p>
</div>
</details>
<details class="ecobox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Il ne signale pas les variables omises, ni l’endogénéité</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p>La sortie reste parfaitement propre. Le <span class="math inline">R^2</span> est honorable, les <span class="math inline">t</span> écrasants, les résidus impeccables — <strong>et le coefficient peut être faux</strong>.</p>
<p>C’est le chapitre 16 et le chapitre 19 réunis, et c’est ce qui distingue un économètre d’un utilisateur de logiciel.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="et-il-ne-choisit-pas-les-écarts-types">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="et-il-ne-choisit-pas-les-écarts-types">Et il ne choisit pas les écarts-types</h3>
<details class="intuitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Le défaut est le plus fragile</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p><code>summary</code> et <code>fit()</code> donnent par défaut les écarts-types <strong>ordinaires</strong> — ceux qui supposent H3 et H4. Sur données individuelles, ce sont presque toujours les mauvais.</p>
<p><strong>Choisir HC1 ou la grappe est une décision de l’économètre</strong>, à justifier par la structure des données : individuelles, ou tirées par groupes.</p>
</div>
</details>
<details class="ecobox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Une checklist en cinq lignes</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<ol type="1">
<li>La variable expliquée a-t-elle la bonne forme — niveau ou logarithme ?</li>
<li>La référence de chaque facteur est-elle celle voulue ?</li>
<li>Les écarts-types sont-ils robustes, ou de grappe s’il le faut ?</li>
<li>Les quatre graphiques ont-ils été regardés ?</li>
<li>Les limites sont-elles écrites ?</li>
</ol>
</div>
</details>
</section>
</section>
<section class="level1" id="sentraîner">
<h2 class="h1">S’entraîner</h2>
<section class="level2" id="exercice-1-relire-une-sortie">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="exercice-1-relire-une-sortie">Exercice 1 : relire une sortie</h3>
<details class="exercicebox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Une ligne de summary</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p>Une sortie R contient la ligne <code>anciennete  270.27  11.72  23.059  &lt; 2e-16</code>, avec <code>496 degrees of freedom</code>.</p>
<ol type="1">
<li>Retrouver le <span class="math inline">t</span> à partir des deux premiers nombres.</li>
<li>Construire l’intervalle de confiance à <span class="math inline">95\,\%</span> (<span class="math inline">t_{496} = 1{,}965</span>) et le comparer à <code>confint</code>.</li>
<li>Que deviendrait le <span class="math inline">t</span> avec l’écart-type robuste <span class="math inline">13{,}00</span> ?</li>
</ol>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="exercice-1-solution">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="exercice-1-solution">Exercice 1 : solution</h3>
<details class="solutionbox">
<summary class="pedago-title">Tout se retrouve à la main</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<ol type="1">
<li><span class="math inline">270{,}27/11{,}72 = 23{,}06</span>.</li>
<li><span class="math inline">270{,}27 \pm 1{,}965 \times 11{,}72 = [247{,}24\,;293{,}30]</span> : exactement la ligne de <code>confint</code>.</li>
<li><span class="math inline">270{,}27/13{,}00 = 20{,}79</span> — la valeur de <code>coeftest</code> avec <code>vcovHC</code>. La conclusion ne change pas ; sa base, si.</li>
</ol>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="exercice-2-traduire">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="exercice-2-traduire">Exercice 2 : traduire</h3>
<details class="exercicebox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">De R vers Python</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p>Écrire en Python l’équivalent de :</p>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb9"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb9-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb9-1" tabindex="-1"></a>mk2 <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">lm</span>(consommation <span class="sc">~</span> revenu <span class="sc">+</span> taille <span class="sc">+</span> milieu, <span class="at">data =</span> men)</span>
<span id="cb9-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb9-2" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">coeftest</span>(mk2, <span class="at">vcov =</span> <span class="fu">vcovCL</span>(mk2, <span class="at">cluster =</span> <span class="sc">~</span> quartier))</span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="exercice-2-solution">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="exercice-2-solution">Exercice 2 : solution</h3>
<details class="solutionbox">
<summary class="pedago-title">Une option au lieu d’une fonction</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb10"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb10-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb10-1" tabindex="-1"></a>f <span class="op">=</span> <span class="st">"consommation ~ revenu + taille + milieu"</span></span>
<span id="cb10-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb10-2" tabindex="-1"></a>mk2 <span class="op">=</span> smf.ols(f, data<span class="op">=</span>men).fit(</span>
<span id="cb10-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb10-3" tabindex="-1"></a>    cov_type<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"cluster"</span>, cov_kwds<span class="op">=</span>{<span class="st">"groups"</span>: men.quartier})</span>
<span id="cb10-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb10-4" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">print</span>(mk2.summary())</span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<p>On retrouve <span class="math inline">101{,}92</span> pour le milieu urbain : les deux logiciels appliquent la même correction de petit nombre de grappes.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="exercice-3-trouver-lerreur">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="exercice-3-trouver-lerreur">Exercice 3 : trouver l’erreur</h3>
<details class="exercicebox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Trois scripts fautifs</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p>Qu’est-ce qui ne va pas ?</p>
<ol type="1">
<li><code>lm(log(depenses_pub) ~ ventes, data = d)</code>, alors que <span class="math inline">40\,\%</span> des entreprises n’ont aucune dépense publicitaire.</li>
<li><code>lm(salaire ~ anciennete + region, data = sal)</code> lu en disant « Casablanca rapporte <span class="math inline">1\,174</span> dirhams de plus que Rabat ».</li>
<li><code>summary(lm(salaire ~ diplome, data = sal))</code> publié tel quel dans un mémoire sur <span class="math inline">500</span> salariés.</li>
</ol>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="exercice-3-solution">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="exercice-3-solution">Exercice 3 : solution</h3>
<details class="solutionbox">
<summary class="pedago-title">Le zéro, la référence, les écarts-types</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<ol type="1">
<li><span class="math inline">\ln 0</span> n’existe pas : R écarte sans prévenir les <span class="math inline">40\,\%</span> d’entreprises sans publicité — l’échantillon a changé. Vérifier <code>nobs</code>.</li>
<li>Les coefficients régionaux se lisent par rapport à la <strong>référence</strong>, ici « Autres » ; la comparaison avec Rabat demande la différence des deux coefficients, et un test.</li>
<li>Écarts-types <strong>ordinaires</strong> sur données individuelles hétéroscédastiques : il faut des écarts-types robustes — et se demander quelles variables manquent.</li>
</ol>
</div>
</details>
</section>
</section>
<section class="level1" id="ce-quil-faut-retenir">
<h2 class="h1">Ce qu’il faut retenir</h2>
<section class="level2" id="le-résumé-du-chapitre">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="le-résumé-du-chapitre">Le résumé du chapitre</h3>
<details class="definitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Six points</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<ol type="1">
<li>Chaque nombre de la sortie de <code>lm</code> ou <code>smf.ols</code> a été calculé à la main dans le cours.</li>
<li><code>relevel</code> ou <code>Treatment</code> fixent la <strong>référence</strong> des indicatrices : à vérifier systématiquement.</li>
<li><code>plot(m)</code> donne les <strong>quatre graphiques</strong> de diagnostic en une instruction.</li>
<li><code>vcovHC</code> et <code>vcovCL</code>, ou <code>cov_type</code>, corrigent les écarts-types sans toucher aux coefficients.</li>
<li><code>linearHypothesis</code> et <code>f_test</code> testent une contrainte <strong>économique</strong>.</li>
<li>Le logiciel ne choisit ni les variables, ni la forme, ni les écarts-types, et ne signale jamais l’<strong>endogénéité</strong>.</li>
</ol>
</div>
</details>
<details class="intuitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">La fin du parcours</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p>Quatre cours, un même fichier de cinq cents salariés : décrit, échantillonné, puis expliqué. <strong>Une seule discipline, enseignée en quatre fois</strong> — et un tableau de régression, que vous savez maintenant lire, en est l’aboutissement.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
</section>
